title: Introduction to Engineering
description: This course explores the field of engineering and its different branches. The course provides hands-on design projects including experimentation, teamwork, ethics, and the application of basic scientific principles to practical situations.
outcomes: Describe the role of engineers in society and classify the different engineering branches, the functions of an engineer, and industries in which they work.
Identify and describe academic pathways to bachelor’s degrees.
Develop and apply effective strategies to succeed academically.
Explain engineering ethical principles and standards.
Demonstrate knowledge of effective practices for writing technical engineering documents and making oral presentations
Analyze engineering problems using the engineering design process.
Demonstrate teamwork skills in working on an engineering design team.
content: Rewards and opportunities of an engineering career
The role of Engineering in society and comparison of engineering, science
Exposure to Modern Engineering Tools and Practices
Academic success, curriculum, pathways, preparation for upper division
Engineering study as preparation for other careers
Role of community college in engineering education
Keys to success in engineering study
Oral Presentation and displaying the data
lab: Formation of Teams and Team Building Exercise
Introduction to Design and Design Method
Presentation Software for Technical writings, calculations and oral Presentation
assignments: Reading from textbook, reference material, and online sources
Projects: Work on a team to design and build a bridge with specifications
Oral Presentations: Explain to the class a proposed design of a robot using visual
Term Paper: Research aeronautical engineering or other branch and present
findings to the class using PowerPoint.
Design reports, lab reports, and memoranda: Submit a design accompanied by a
concise explanation for a small vehicle powered by a mousetrap.
